judgmentContext.author: Codex /root/relevance_evaluation, source-reading evaluator
judgmentContext.labelMethod: Read frozen current source sections; assign answer sources before production ranking. No post-ranking relabeling.
judgmentContext.limitations: Single evaluator; English technical self-documentation; 34 sections from five allowlisted files; incomplete labels except explicitly bounded navigation and empty cases; no representative user distribution.

equivalence.native: raveldex-bm25-v1; basic-v1 NFKC then lowercase; frozen title boost2/body boost1
equivalence.foreign: MiniSearch7.2.0 companion-v1; basic-v1 NFC then lowercase then NFC; same declared boosts
equivalence.queries: Explicit typed translation only for simple exact AND/OR text, strict source phrase, scalar equality conjunction/browse and one prefix variant. Arbitrary Boolean trees, null equality and native alternative weighting are not comparable.
equivalence.filters: Scalar sourcePath/category equality only where requested. Extended predicates and facet outputs not selected.
equivalence.phrases: Strict normalized original token sequence in one original field value, complete candidates before exact totals; no cross-value/field adjacency.
equivalence.counts: Exact complete totals and complete limit100 results for34 section corpus. Cutoff100 exceeds entire corpus.
equivalence.retainedSource: Native explicitly retains title/body originals; companion always retains full source and metadata.
equivalence.execution: Direct Node same process sequential calls; UI=false,worker=false,storage=false.
equivalence.output: Native returns IDs/scores/total only; companion additionally computes mandatory original evidence/snippets even with returnFields empty. Output cost is not identical.
equivalence.ranking: Different model scores are observed, never required equal or used as correctness oracle. Prefix discount/aggregation/statistics differ.
unsupported: native successful tokenless empty result (companion rejects)

limitations.analyzer: basic-v1 uses NFC-lowercase-NFC; native basic-v1 uses NFKC-lowercase
limitations.scoring: Upstream MiniSearch BM25 policy k=1.2 b=0.7 d=0.5; field lengths and multi-term combination differ from native BM25.
limitations.numericalExplanation: Unavailable: upstream-not-exposed. No native term facts or score decomposition are manufactured.
limitations.cancellation: Companion public signals check before dispatch and between staged work; synchronous upstream MiniSearch retrieval is not interruptible.
limitations.phrase: Companion global tokens/phrase mode verifies adjacency within one original field value; native phrase is an optional query leaf.
limitations.capacity: Companion fixed admission ceilings: 10000 records, 16 text fields, 32 schema fields, 50000 units/text value, 128 values/text array, 100000 array slots, 10000000 source string units, 1000000 indexed tokens; result limit 1..100.
limitations.persistence: Foreign source snapshots require conversion and native rebuild; opaque upstream indexes are unsupported.
